about.en: GF is the governance token of GoldFinger, a project that links precious-metal assets such as gold, silver and copper to Web3 under a dual-token model, in which GF governs the ecosystem alongside a separate asset-linked token. GF is a BEP-20 on BNB Chain at 0x6db461da03b8ad06319ff2af985e1c8dfcc004e0 (6 decimals); it is not itself a claim on any metal.
